description: This file contains internal utility functions, templates, and classes used by Google Mock for C++ testing, including type traits, array and container views, and failure reporting mechanisms.
external_methods: GTEST_API_ void Log(LogSeverity, const std::string&, int)

classes.name: PointeeOf
classes.description: Template struct to determine the type pointed to by a pointer or smart pointer.

classes.name: LinkedPtrLessThan
classes.description: Comparator for linked_ptr to be stored in sets.

classes.name: FailureReporterInterface
classes.description: Interface for reporting test failures, either fatal or non-fatal.

classes.name: WithoutMatchers
classes.description: Marker class used for resolving parameterless expectations.

classes.name: StlContainerView
classes.description: Template class providing a container view for STL-style containers or native arrays.

classes.name: RemoveConstFromKey
classes.description: Template struct to remove const qualifier from the key of a pair.

classes.name: BooleanConstant
classes.description: Template struct mapping booleans to types.

methods.name: JoinAsTuple
methods.description: Joins a vector of strings into a tuple-like string.

methods.name: ConvertIdentifierNameToWords
methods.description: Converts an identifier name to a space-separated list of lowercase words.

methods.name: GetRawPointer
methods.description: Returns the raw pointer underlying a smart pointer or the pointer itself if already raw.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with a given severity, optionally including a stack trace.

methods.name: Assert
methods.description: Asserts a condition, aborting with a message if false.

methods.name: Expect
methods.description: Verifies a condition, generating a non-fatal failure if false.

methods.name: Invalid
methods.description: Returns an invalid value of type T that terminates if used at runtime.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a function to a tuple of arguments using C++11 features.

calls: GTEST_API_ void Log(LogSeverity, const std::string&, int)
